zc.recipes.journal.landing: Everything I learn to make goes in here.$(br2)Recipes are on $(l)crumpled notes$() lost in houses, shops and bases. Repeats can be traded.
zc.recipes.flavor.primeiros_passos: $(o)Without tools you go nowhere. Flint hides in gravel, fiber comes from grass with a knife.$()$(br2)Knife first. Everything else comes from it.
zc.recipes.flavor.abrigo: $(o)A good base closes, lights up and feeds you.$()$(br2)Nails are gold: any iron nugget will do. Do not waste torches, light draws attention.
zc.recipes.flavor.saude: $(o)Dirty cloth gets infected. Boil the water, boil the cloth.$()$(br2)A deep cut needs stitches. A broken bone needs a splint, and rest.
zc.recipes.flavor.roupas: $(o)The cold kills slower than the dead, but it kills.$()$(br2)Torn clothes are mended with thread and a needle. Leather stops bites.
zc.recipes.flavor.equipamento: $(o)Carry more, go out less.$()$(br2)Gun parts only turn up in barracks and police stations. Do not waste them.
zc.recipes.flavor.maquinas: $(o)Water turns the wheel, the wheel turns the shaft, the shaft turns the rest.$()$(br2)With the press you make plates without hammering all day.
